items: E1a: retain exact post-output-norm physical-C3 prompt streaming
C3 remains explicit pending complete promotion and serving gates
title: Qwen3.8 Q4_K_M physical-C3 MTP prompt streaming

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

protocol.correctness: self-exact greedy IDs, route expectation, budget conformance, and exact E0 acceptance trajectory
protocol.anti_gaming: all ten fixed categories plus heldouts; one model/quant/profile/width policy key; no prompt/category/length selector

commands.clean_c3_k3: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 .venv/bin/python3 scripts/gguf_mtp_c1c8_server_bench.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --quant Q4_K_M --execution-profile production --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --widths 3 --resident-capacity 3 --max-tokens 24 --candidate-budget 3 --batch-window-ms 50 --max-sequence-length 1024 --expected-mtp-widths 3 --generation2-diagnostic --correctness-contract mtp_self_exact --output /tmp/p250-e1a-c3k3-clean.json
commands.stage_ledger: same cached environment; scripts/specdec2_perf_bridge.py --backend hip_gfx1151 --target-arch gfx1151 --quant-label Q4_K_M --execution-profile production --scope train --limit 1 --concurrency 3 --budgets 3 --max-tokens 24 --runs 1 --warmup --roctx-markers --profile-child --output /tmp/p250-e1a-c3k3-profile.json
commands.strict_c1_d24: same canonical server harness with execution-profile strict, width/resident-capacity 1, D24, K3; output /tmp/p250-e1a-c1k3-clean.json
commands.strict_c1_d25_scope_check: same strict-C1 command at max-tokens 25; output /tmp/p250-e1a-c1k3-natural25-clean.json

c3_k3_complete_wall.promotion_gate: overall and every category exceed true AR; complete production/serving policy gates remain pending

prompt_length_bins.note: Length bins are diagnostic only and do not affect routing. The shortest bin is positive versus E0 but 0.30% below the per-bin 1.10x ratio; the binding promotion rule is overall plus non-regressive categories.

stage_ledger_train_prompt.ttft_note: The profile child does not expose client/scheduler TTFT directly. Target-prefill plus initial provider attachment is the measured activation-to-first-decode owner: 1.2899 s at E0 versus 0.7011 s at E1a (-45.6%). Direct SSE TTFT remains part of the later serving gate.

correctness.post_output_norm_contract: streamed BF16 rows are output-normalized on device before shifted NextN consumption; normalized tails are reused for target sampling
correctness.rejected_screen: The first pre-output-norm screen reached 27.068 tok/s but changed acceptance to 468/597 and was rejected before retention.

strict_c1_d25.note: The temporary Generation-2 diagnostic plan is D24-only. This check does not supersede the separate natural25 automatic serving evidence and is not a product-admission result.

adjacent_controls.production_c2: No prompt sinks are admitted at physical C2; host replay and the existing explicit/K0 policy are unchanged by construction and covered by scope tests.

scope.automatic_mtp_policy: unchanged; C3 remains explicit until the complete D7 production and serving bundle passes

verdict.reason: The exact post-output-norm C3 path improves complete MTP wall overall and in every category without changing generated IDs or the E0 acceptance trajectory.
verdict.next: E1b exact physical proposal-head row reuse; only 0.346 tok/s (1.26%) remains to the frozen external K3 row.
